document.subtitle: Client-facing operating guide and user acceptance testing evidence

sections.title: Customer Registration
sections.summary: Register an organization, provide required business information, submit it for Sales review, and activate an approved customer account.
steps: Start the organization registration and complete company and contact information.
Upload required documents, add delivery locations, and set map coordinates.
Nominate the Customer Administrator, review the application, and submit it.
Sales reviews, approves, and activates the customer account through the authorized workflow.

sections.title: Customer Portal
sections.audience: Customer Administrator, Purchaser, Finance User, and Viewer according to role permissions
sections.summary: Use the authenticated Customer Portal to view account information, products, quotations, direct orders, order details, and delivery locations according to the assigned role.
steps: Sign in through the shared Customer Portal login.
Use the dashboard and role-aware navigation to open permitted modules.
Review product details and create quotation or direct-order requests where authorized.
Maintain mapped Ship-to locations before using them for delivery orders.

sections.title: Sales / Quotations
sections.audience: Sales Representative and customer quotation participants
sections.summary: Review customer registrations and quotation requests, apply approved commercial pricing, send quotations to customers, and record the customer decision.
steps: Sign in through the shared internal login and open the relevant Sales queue.
Review the quotation requirements and start the review when valid.
Apply the configured commercial pricing and required approval path.
Send the final quotation to the customer for acceptance or another supported decision.

sections.title: Contract
sections.audience: Sales Representative and Customer Portal users with contract access
sections.summary: Convert an accepted quotation into a draft contract, review the inherited commercial snapshot, activate the contract, and make the active contract visible to the customer.
steps: Open an accepted quotation and select Create Contract.
Enter only the permitted contract-specific information and confirm creation.
Review the draft contract and activate it when valid.
Confirm that the active contract is visible in the Customer Portal.

sections.title: Orders
sections.audience: Authorized customer users and Sales Representative
sections.summary: Create orders from active contracts, review and submit them, monitor the customer order list, and allow Sales to begin processing submitted orders.
steps: Open an active contract and start an order.
Enter the requested quantity in TON and select the permitted fulfilment details.
Review and confirm the order.
Sales opens the submitted order and starts processing after validation.

sections.title: Hader Delivery
sections.audience: Hader Manager and authorized Hader operational users
sections.summary: Convert processing delivery orders into delivery requests and shipments, schedule resources, load the shipment, and dispatch it into the delivery workflow.
steps: Open the delivery request and create the shipment.
Assign dispatch resources and schedule the shipment.
Use Loading Control to assign a compatible loading point and complete loading.
Dispatch the loaded shipment; dispatch does not mark it delivered.

sections.title: Proof of Delivery (POD)
sections.summary: Move a dispatched shipment through in-transit and delivered states, record proof of delivery for the delivered shipment, and close the shipment after valid POD exists.
steps: Start delivery for a dispatched shipment.
Mark the in-transit shipment delivered when delivery is complete.
Record receiver, delivered quantity, delivery time, location, evidence, and permitted POD documents.
Close the shipment after POD is recorded.

sections.title: Ship-to Variance
sections.summary: Review shipments delivered to a different pricing city, compare the stored ordered and actual city prices, and either dismiss the variance or raise the calculated extra charge for approval.
steps: Open the Ship-to Variance list and select a shipment.
Review the stored pricing comparison, difference per TON, and extra charge.
Raise a genuine positive extra charge for Commercial Director approval or dismiss it where appropriate.

sections.title: Pricing Administrator
sections.summary: Maintain product records, city-based product and delivery pricing, Hader city boundaries, logistics master data, pickup locations, and central VAT configuration.
steps: Maintain active products and their customer-visible information.
Configure product and delivery list prices using the established per-TON basis.
Maintain permitted city, fleet, pickup-location, transporter, and VAT configuration.
Keep internal pricing and logistics costs restricted to authorized users.

sections.title: Commercial Director
sections.summary: Review pending Ship-to Variance extra-charge requests and approve or reject them without altering the historical variance calculation.
steps: Open the pending variance approvals queue.
Review the shipment, order, city-price comparison, and calculated charge.
Approve the request or reject it with the required reason.

sections.title: Portal Administrator
sections.audience: Portal Administrator and Customer Administrator for their respective user-management screens
sections.summary: Portal Administrators manage internal users through the protected administration area. Customer Administrators separately create and manage other users belonging to their own customer account.
steps: Portal Administrator signs in through the dedicated administration login.
Create or maintain internal users with the existing roles and active status.
Customer Administrator uses Customer Portal User Management for other users in the same account.
Use Profile, not the Users list, for the currently authenticated customer user's own account.

uatCases.scenario: Complete and submit an organization registration.
uatCases.expectedResult: A valid application reference is created and the application is submitted for Sales review.

uatCases.scenario: Review, approve, and activate a submitted registration.
uatCases.expectedResult: The approved customer account is activated through the authorized Sales workflow.

uatCases.scenario: Sign in through the shared Customer Portal login.
uatCases.expectedResult: The authenticated user reaches the Customer Portal and sees role-permitted navigation.

uatCases.scenario: Browse products and open product details.
uatCases.expectedResult: Only active customer-visible product information and permitted prices are displayed.

uatCases.scenario: Create and submit a quotation request.
uatCases.expectedResult: The quotation is created with selected products and enters Pending Sales Review.

uatCases.scenario: Create, review, and submit a direct order.
uatCases.expectedResult: The order is created with TON-based quantity, configured VAT, and Submitted status.

uatCases.scenario: Save a Ship-to location with a valid map position.
uatCases.expectedResult: Coordinates persist and the location can be used in delivery orders.

uatCases.scenario: Open the Sales applications list and review an application.
uatCases.expectedResult: The selected customer application opens with its submitted details.

uatCases.scenario: Review and price a customer quotation.
uatCases.expectedResult: Configured list prices load and the quotation follows the required commercial approval path.

uatCases.scenario: Review and accept a quotation ready for the customer.
uatCases.expectedResult: The quotation status becomes Accepted and internal pricing components remain hidden.

uatCases.scenario: Create a contract from an accepted quotation.
uatCases.expectedResult: One draft contract is created with a locked accepted commercial snapshot.

uatCases.scenario: Activate a valid draft contract.
uatCases.expectedResult: The contract becomes Active without repeating quotation pricing approval.

uatCases.scenario: View an active customer contract.
uatCases.expectedResult: The customer sees only its own active contract and combined customer-facing commercial rate.

uatCases.scenario: Create and submit an order from an active contract.
uatCases.expectedResult: The order is submitted and remaining contract TON is validated and updated transactionally.

uatCases.scenario: Start processing a valid submitted order.
uatCases.expectedResult: Order status changes from Submitted to Processing and the action is recorded.

uatCases.scenario: Create a shipment from a valid delivery request.
uatCases.expectedResult: A shipment is created using the existing order and delivery data.

uatCases.scenario: Assign resources, schedule, and dispatch a loaded shipment.
uatCases.expectedResult: The shipment becomes Dispatched and is ready for Delivery Team action; it is not marked Delivered.

uatCases.scenario: Assign a compatible loading point and complete loading.
uatCases.expectedResult: Loading completes using compatible silo or bagging-line capacity without treating capacity as stock.

uatCases.scenario: Start delivery and mark an in-transit shipment delivered.
uatCases.expectedResult: The shipment moves through Dispatched, In Transit, and Delivered using authorized actions.

uatCases.scenario: Record POD and close a delivered shipment.
uatCases.expectedResult: POD is stored once for the shipment and the shipment can then be closed.

uatCases.scenario: Raise a positive calculated extra charge.
uatCases.expectedResult: The stored variance snapshot enters Pending Commercial Director Approval without changing original order pricing.

uatCases.scenario: Maintain product and city-based product prices.
uatCases.expectedResult: The active product and authoritative per-TON city prices are saved and available to pricing lookups.

uatCases.scenario: Maintain city delivery prices and boundaries.
uatCases.expectedResult: Configured standard and white-cement delivery prices and city boundaries are available to authorized workflows.

uatCases.scenario: Maintain logistics master data, pickup locations, and VAT configuration.
uatCases.expectedResult: Valid configuration saves through authorized administration APIs.

uatCases.scenario: Approve a pending Ship-to Variance extra charge.
uatCases.expectedResult: The request becomes Approved with authenticated approver and timestamp; downstream financial posting remains pending.

uatCases.scenario: Create and maintain an internal portal user.
uatCases.expectedResult: The user is created with a hashed password, assigned role, and active status without exposing credentials.

uatCases.scenario: Create and edit another user in the same customer account.
uatCases.expectedResult: The user is tenant-scoped, securely created, and manageable without exposing the authenticated administrator in the Users list.
